text_block_list.text:
If you're lookin' for an emcee, look no
further than me: the
silver-tongued,
world's strongest—ELLLL CONDOR
PASAAAAA!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I think El's conjuring the wrong type
of emcee for this, but...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I grant you the right to hear my
inspirational words! Be
grateful!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...On second thought, this concert
celebrates all of us. Perhaps it
would be
more appropriate to express my
individuality as well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to try leading the audience in a
final clap to end the
festivities. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So, um, the next song is... Hehe, hehe! Ah
no! I laughed again!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Oh, Urara? Have I missed something?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking of how big and full of
fun this concert is going to
be, and it made
me so excited, I started laughing during
my emcee
speech.
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
In that case, you've no need to withhold
your laughter! The audience
came to see
you, meaning it is unnecessary that you
force a
performative persona!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Really?! I see! Then I can be an emcee who
laughs all the time!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
